description: This file provides WebAssembly integration for image resizing, including functions to load, initialize, and perform resize operations using wasm modules.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Performs image resizing using WebAssembly module, taking input image data and output dimensions, returning resized image data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and instantiates the WebAssembly module, handling different response types and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the wasm module, fetching and setting up the wasm instance.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes references to wasm and memory buffers to trigger garbage collection.
